why: Two new rules fill 09:27-29:52 (~20 of 33 min): 09:27-19:13 non-human plurals take feminine singular adjectives and verbs (11:14 'feminine version of an adjective for plurals', 13:12 'It's only a proposal... We're not learning it', 17:10 'سيارات بتمشي or بيمشو'), then 19:16-29:52 the -ish negation he asked for (19:29 'You just add ish', 21:30 'when we review the collocations... we're gonna use this version of I don't'), drilled with تنزعجش, تنبسطش, انبسطتش. 00:43-09:20 is warm-up talk with fixes (آخر اجتماع / اجتماعي الأخير, the date, the weather); from 29:34 he takes a work call and the lesson ends at 33:10.

the car goes fast (بتمشي = runs, of a car)
I didn't enjoy / I wasn't happy

not_taught.reason: named once at 14:31 in a list of non-human nouns (دروس، بيوت، ضيوف، ثروة) as a grammar example; not glossed, given or asked for

summary.headline: New: -ish negation (bakulesh, biddesh, tinzi3ijish) + a preview of feminine treatment for non-human plurals

rules.title: Add -ish to say 'don't': bakulesh, biddesh, behkish
bullets: -ish at the end makes the verb negative
ما بديش also works, just stronger
verbs ending in a long vowel keep it: بحكي - بحكيش
we'll use this form when reviewing collocations

examples.line: ما بديش أحكي - I don't want to speak

rules.title: Command with -ish keeps the t: تنزعجش, تنبسطش
bullets: don't + command = the 'you' present form + ish
انزعجش without the t doesn't work

examples.line: tinbastish fiyo ktir - don't enjoy it too much

rules.title: Past with -ish: inbastatish
bullets: the t-t sounds are mashed together

rules.title: Non-human plurals are treated as feminine singular: الدروس صعبة
bullets: only for things, not people (not طلاب, أولاد)
adjective, verb and preposition all go feminine
a preview: studied properly when we review plurals

examples.line: الدروس صعبة - the lessons are hard
الدروس فيها أشياء - the lessons have things in them
سيارات بتمشي or بيمشو - cars run

rules.title: My last meeting: اجتماعي الأخير or آخر اجتماع
bullets: اجتماع is masculine, so الأخير without a t

also: Warm-up talk 00:43-09:20: his busy morning, three meetings, the date, the weather and temperature
Homework talk 08:28-09:40: the plurals of أول and آخر
Off-lesson 29:57-33:05: Medi's work call; the lesson ends at 33:10
